sources.name: Poly Haven
notes: Best first choice for high-quality CC0 HDRIs, materials/textures and 3D models.
When AurorA uses the live API, surface Poly Haven as the asset source and send a unique AurorA Studio User-Agent.

sources.name: ambientCG
notes: The provider explicitly warns that the API is operated by one person and should not be treated as enterprise-stable.
Cache imported assets locally instead of making production depend on API uptime.

sources.name: Kenney
notes: Kenney states game assets on its asset pages are CC0 and may be used commercially without attribution.
Prefer source-page download and store the source URL with the imported asset.

sources.name: Quaternius
notes: Strong source for stylized 3D, rigged characters and animation libraries.
Newer assets may use Quaternius Asset License (QAL) v1.0: commercial finished products are allowed and attribution is not required, but raw assets may not be redistributed.
Some older pack pages remain CC0. Record the exact license shown for the asset at download time.
Never bundle a QAL raw asset into the AurorA Studio community package.

sources.name: Openverse
notes: Use Openverse to discover openly licensed images/audio.
Openverse explicitly does not guarantee license metadata accuracy.
Before importing, verify the license on the original source and store attribution requirements.
